reason: We already have a designer, so a carousel about measuring letters doesn't give me a reason to comment 11 or DM a studio I don't need yet. Free look or not, it's one more thing to manage in a week that's already full.
objection: If I'm going to spend on brand work, why would I switch from the designer we have when this is only a pretty post and I can't see what I'd get for the money?
would_change_my_mind: A clear, published price range for a brand identity, plus proof that the studio has done a project for a business like ours at a cost lower than what we pay our designer now.
